g.title: rover.fxns.plan_path
g.text: Plan the next drive move based on the current state of the rover.

g.title: rover.fxns.plan_path.m
g.text: Possible modes for rover path planning.
....navigating_rover crashed or maximum deviation from the path breached
....navigating_rover is in operation and sending position signals
....navigating_rover is shut off due to an emergency

g.title: rover.fxns.plan_path.p
g.text: ....(if drift is present, takes values between -1 and 1)
....(if transfer is low or hgih: takes values between -1 and 1)

g.title: rover.fxns.plan_path.s
g.text: States used in rover path planning.

g.title: rover.fxns.plan_path.correct_fault_vel
g.text: Slow down the rover when faults are detected.

g.title: rover.fxns.plan_path.drive_control
g.text: Control of rpower/lpower signal based on percieved line.

g.title: rover.fxns.plan_path.dynamic_behavior
g.text: Step 2A: If Operational Mode is Drive determine if the rover has reached
the end point or emergency shut off is required and assign those modes
Step 2B: if none of the situations in step 2 applies, determines the
control signal for left and right motor power, based on percieced line
